prompt_fragment:
This asset is UI chrome or ornamentation. Keep it decorative, controlled, and cleanly cuttable from the background.
Keep decorative edges controlled and production-friendly for UI extraction.
raw_description:
A centered compass rose in the style of an antique nautical chart —
eight-pointed star with elongated N-S axis, fleur-de-lis at north,
finely inked concentric degree rings.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor antique nautical chart detail on aged vellum cream parchment, a centered eight-pointed compass rose with elongated north-south axis, rendered in slate ink linework with warm ochre and ember orange accents punctuating the cardinal points.

subjects.description: Eight-pointed star with dramatically elongated north-south axis, fleur-de-lis finial at north point, fine nib crosshatching on cardinal petals, concentric degree-ring annotations in tight serif numerals
Two thin concentric circles enclosing fine tick-mark gradations, hand-lettered compass bearings in archival ink, faint foxing dots scattered across the vellum field
